Aequissimam vocat usuram, & charitati Christianae consentaneam, modo non exigant, &c., nec omnes dent ad foenus, sed ii qui in pecuniis bona habent, & ob aetatem, sexum, artis alicujus ignorantiam, non possunt uti. translations.literal: Zanchius says nearly this in his commentary on chapter 4 to the Ephesians. He calls usury most equitable and consistent with Christian charity, provided they do not exact, etc., nor do all give at interest, but those who have goods in money, and on account of age, sex, ignorance of some art, cannot use them.
